tone: Use neutral, concise Russian with polite impersonal software phrasing.
capitalization: Use sentence case and Russian capitalization rules, not English title case.
button_labels: Use short conventional action labels, normally infinitives, without final periods.
ui_roles: Keep labels concise, buttons action-oriented, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Use established Russian software terms and preserve glossary tokens exactly.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from the feature and UI context; avoid one global equivalent and avoid calques that change the technical sense.
punctuation: Use Russian quotation and punctuation rules while preserving accelerators and syntax.
units: Use metric conventions, comma decimals where locale formatting applies, and nonbreaking unit spacing.
natural_language: Choose idiomatic Russian syntax and avoid calques from English.
